requirements.normative_statement: Tauri v2 modular monolith; pure domain, one-way service/storage/provider dependency.
AppState startup/shutdown, canonical app-data/temp paths, typed errors and cancellation.
Per-draft single writer; no SQLite transaction/DB lock across network await; nonblocking consistent reads.
WAL, synchronous FULL, foreign_keys ON, busy_timeout 5000 on all connections.
Materialize the SF-06 B+ header/child/pending target within exactly 66 DBML tables; preserve all other physical tables/indexes/FKs/CHECKs; no unrelated schema.
PRAGMA user_version forward migrations, backup API, rollback, schema/FK/integrity checks.
Preserve legacy rows, nullable SF-06 evidence and phase; fail closed; no automatic genesis.
Nullable collection, TrackedField provenance and no AI fabrication; protected-write enforcement is delegated to the tool-owner requirement.
Stable entity codes, per-parent monotone _counters, restore consistency.
Exactly 46 master attributes and confirmed/AI composite provenance precedence.
Q1 transitive cascade, full impact preview, protected descendants, atomic reject.
Readiness, progress, validation; invalid world_setting_code blocks commit.
UAX #29/CJK deterministic word count for Writing Mode.
RFC8785 JCS state bytes exclude meta.updated_at; compare bytes not only hash.
Versioned pure atomic clone patch, provenance/counters/arrays/cascade/noop/zero-net; golden vectors.
Durable canonical plan/request digests and frozen P; reject unsupported codecs.
WorldProbeReportV1 and exact WorldWriteInputV1 consumer projection with refs, budget and hashes.
Round header, exact task membership, composite FKs; legacy child fields retained.
Durable historical verifier separates integrity, attestation, current applicability; lookup before OCC.
TX-04 header/receipts/evidence/optional version/head; zero-net header but no fake version.
Restore divergence, legacy Unknown, lost response and artifact integrity without LLM/tool replay.
Protected user/user_edited fields become pending proposals; no direct AI overwrite.
TX-08 proposal durability is independent of TX-04 and commits before patch_id response.
TX-02 confirm/reject/batch; revalidate data and eligibility on cumulative candidate.
Orphan cases A-F, dedupe origin, Restore expiry, concurrent CAS, legacy fail-closed.
TX-01 one sealed version per turn; idempotent seal, append-only Restore TX-03, retry/lost response.
Registry caller/source metadata; AI cannot call UI-only tools; field-level structured outcomes.
Required read/write tools and catalog retrieval across business phases.
Outline windows, balanced tasks, frozen MAX_PARALLEL, deterministic task_index application.
Cancellation waits for started mutations and seals valid completed round; no fake saved state.
Phase3 probe, pure merge/tree, parent-before-child write; temp reports not durable proof.
ReAct/tool loop, rejected threshold, completed tool results, controlled-exit sealing.
Prompt blocks/tools JIT and distinct system_language vs project.language.
Start/commit blocks pending patches and validation failure, no automatic resolution.
TX-05 topo code→UUID insert, FK/collision rollback, reopen restriction.
Project/character library read/write, cross-project sharing and safe delete.
Writing opens only on committed plan; chapter-first real scene IDs and ordered read model.
Scene stream/cancel/EditScope; Lock invalidates generation forever, Accept remains review-only.
TX-06 immediate user-only lock; TX-07 atomic chapter Save OCC/idempotency/dirty-scene only.
Ollama/OpenCode adapters, permission all deny, timeouts/cancellation/error mapping.
Keychain/session-only fallback, no plaintext secret in DB/log, redaction, path protection.
ErrorCode/IpcError typed boundary and DTO camelCase without changing snake_case storage.
All 40 commands in 10 groups with caller authorization and 3 event channels.
Streaming event lifecycle, cancellation, FE reconciliation and loss handling.
Preserve UI layout/routes/breakpoints; additive integration and visual regression.
Replace mock chat/draft with real data, readiness, progress, feedback context.
Pending/restore/workflow/commit recovery statuses and zero-net semantics.
Project/character data, source, cascade, no visible code slugs.
Writing UI lock/stream/review/save/version with real IDs and dirty buffer preserved.
Provider/config UI reflects backend; no mock data presented as durable.
T-*, MIG/WF/IPC, WF-C/DB-P, REC matrices run on disposable databases.
Existing 39 Node tests stay green; add independent IPC/FE integration and visual checks.
Tauri startup, registration, shutdown and recovery before IPC available.
Two-tier visual system and i18n chrome preserved (config/worldbuilding exceptions).
